title: A notice printed on cloth
blurb: An article with a link, a button and a checkbox hangs from four pegs as a sheet of cloth. Pull a corner, send a gust through it or scroll the page, and it swings. Its controls can be pressed while it moves, because the hit box follows the triangle under the pointer.
question: A cloth has no single matrix. Can the controls on an element drawn as a moving cloth still be pressed where they're drawn?
result: Yes, at the pointer. The cloth is 216 triangles from one copy of the element. One draw with no alpha, under the matrix of the triangle beneath the pointer, puts the hit box right at that place. Away from the pointer it's wrong, which doesn't matter until the pointer moves.
